items.title: 跳跃输入容错 · Jump input buffering
items.content:
这是 Aftermark 自写的示例笔记，不是外部视频的转录，也不是已验证的项目结论。

跳跃输入缓冲（jump input buffering）会短暂记住玩家提前按下的跳跃输入，在角色满足跳跃条件时消费这次输入。应用前检查控制器是否已经实现输入缓冲，以及是否会重复触发。

This original example describes remembering a recent jump press, then consuming it once jumping becomes valid. Inspect existing input handling before changing it. Tune and test in the actual game; this note does not prove a particular duration feels better.
items.intent: 改善跳跃操作容错，但不增加按键。Keep the existing controls; consider input buffering only when relevant.

items.title: 比较实验结果前的检查 · Experiment checks
items.content:
Aftermark 原创示例。比较实验分数时，先检查训练集和测试集划分、重复样本，以及评估脚本是否一致。使用公开基准的固定划分时，不自行重划数据。

Before interpreting an experiment score difference, inspect dataset splits, duplicate samples and evaluation scripts. Keep an official benchmark split unchanged. These checks do not automatically establish a causal improvement.
items.intent: 分析实验结果前，先检查数据泄漏和评估条件。Check leakage and comparable evaluation conditions before drawing conclusions.

items.title: 借鉴布局，保留品牌 · Layout reference
items.content:
Aftermark 原创示例。参考网站时，把可借鉴的内容层次、阅读顺序和留白，与已有的品牌配色分开考虑。移动端优先保证主要内容和操作可见。

When using a layout reference, separate hierarchy, reading order and spacing from the project's existing brand colors. On mobile, keep primary content and controls easy to reach.
items.intent: 优化拥挤页面时参考布局思路，保留原有品牌颜色。Borrow the structure, not the palette.
